specific_physical_pathways: Ground HeI is transparent below24.59eV, but excited/metastable HeI has low ionization thresholds. It can absorb near-UV/optical photons, compete for H pumping/ionizing radiation and heat the electrons.

Metastable2tripletS is supplied by recombination cascades and collision pathways, and depleted by rapid near-UV photoionization, collisions and radiative transitions. A ground-only charge model omits these paths.

At outer historical supplied state,2tripletS photoionization is about5012.5/s; few threshold-ionizing stellar photons and rapid metastable destruction help keep its population small. This balance changes with T and the internal radiation.
Omitted excitation stages of already included elements and wholly missing elements can cool through collisionally excited lines while their contribution to ne is small.
TiII uses four independent legacy multiplets in the actual C23 default. The two3364.7/3237.1Angstrom channels dominate the identified historical missing cooling.

next_qualification_at_final_native_root: Freeze final T,nH,ne, composition, atomic cutoffs, incident boundary and numerical grids. Identify actual H line-contribution cells rather than treating the historical1.1-1.8Rp window as a measured contribution function.

For representative inner and line-forming cells, expose the actual attenuated+diffuse internal radiation. At fixed T,nH and the same radiation, evaluate excited-He populations, net absorption including stimulated recombination, direct photoheat, collision/line energy, recombination and photon branching. Separate same-radiation response from re-solved transport response.
Construct a matched omission forcing deltaF for He, Ti and any selected missing stage separately on the same complete operator. Record charge/electron/energy effects, not only line luminosities.

Once the root Jacobian and implicit derivative are qualified, use delta_state=-J_inverse*deltaF and the observer tangent to estimate response. This is a linear prediction, not a rigorous bound by itself.

Check the linear prediction with a controlled nonlinear re-solve and the same unchanged prospective state, heat and observer acceptance criteria. If no bound or re-solve is available, keep reduction_adequacy unknown.

If excited-He forcing is material at the final state, add a source-backed singlet/triplet reduced atom with cascade/recombination feeding, reverse rates, photoionization, spontaneous loss and line/continuum energy together. A metastable opacity-only patch is not a closed physical model.

Positive saved C23 cooling channels are net grouped process contributions. The unprinted-channel remainder bounds this saved list, not missing gross heating or a nonlinear thermal error.
The constant-T recombination cooling cache is not qualified here; no complete cooling balance is inferred from it.
